findings.claim: After the move from router.push to loadFullPage, the 'does not finish / does not redirect' tests still assert only `pushMock` not called. The component never calls router.push now, so these negative assertions pass whatever the code does.
findings.impact: If a regression made CompleteStep navigate to /admin when complete-setup or a pre-submit save fails (for example, loadFullPage moved above the `!res.ok` check or into `finally`), no test would fail. A user would then be sent to /admin with setup unfinished, and the error message would never show.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/app/setup/__tests__/CompleteStep.test.tsx:70-78 ('does not redirect on failure') checks only `expect(pushMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled()`. SetupWizard.test.tsx:499, :921 and :946 do the same. CompleteStep.tsx no longer imports useRouter (lines 1-7), so pushMock can never be called. The positive tests were switched to loadFullPageMock (CompleteStep.test.tsx:58; SetupWizard.test.tsx:203, 502, 524, 753, 795, 834, 880, 959), but the negative ones were not.
findings.repro: Mutation: in CompleteStep.tsx move `loadFullPage("/admin")` from line 58 into the `finally` block at line 61. Reading the tests, 'does not redirect on failure' (CompleteStep.test.tsx:70) and the SetupWizard tests at :893 and :924 still pass, because they assert pushMock, not loadFullPageMock. The tests were not executed.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant. Test assertions that this change made vacuous would let a user-visible regression through.

findings.proposed_fix: In CompleteStep.test.tsx:77 and SetupWizard.test.tsx:499, :921 and :946, assert `expect(loadFullPageMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled()`, either in place of or alongside the pushMock assertion.

findings.claim: `loadFullPage` in fullPageLoad.ts is mocked in every test that reaches it. No test checks that it actually performs a document navigation.
findings.impact: If the helper body were changed to a client-side navigation or a no-op, all tests would stay green. The stale sidebar, addon catalogue and WebSocket filter that this fix addresses would come back unnoticed. The function is one line, so the practical risk is small.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/lib/fullPageLoad.ts:7-9 sets `window.location.href = path`. vi.mock('@/lib/fullPageLoad') replaces it at unlock/__tests__/page.test.tsx:20-22, CompleteStep.test.tsx:6-8 and SetupWizard.test.tsx:6-8. Grep found no test that imports the real module.
findings.repro: Mutation: replace the body of fullPageLoad.ts:8 with `window.history.pushState(null, "", path)`. Reading the tests, none would fail. The tests were not executed.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant is declared. This is a coverage gap around the mechanism the fix depends on.

findings.proposed_fix: Add a small test that stubs window.location and asserts that `href` is set to the path.

specification_compliance: The /unlock page ends a successful unlock with loadFullPage(resolveRedirect()) at unlock/page.tsx:35. loadFullPage sets window.location.href (fullPageLoad.ts:8), which is a document navigation equivalent to the earlier window.location.assign.
Redirect sanitising is unchanged. unlock/page.tsx:19-25 accepts a path that starts with '/' but not '//', and otherwise uses '/'.
A wrong password or a failed request leaves the viewer on /unlock with the error (page.tsx:36-41). Unchanged.

r1 finding R2 (the setup wizard unlocks a session, then navigates client-side) is resolved. CompleteStep.tsx:58 now calls loadFullPage('/admin') after complete-setup succeeds. The wizard's unlock happens in onBeforeSubmit (SetupWizard.tsx:281-291), before that point.
CompleteStep still navigates only on success: the `!res.ok` branch returns before line 58, and the catch block does not navigate.
The Lock path (Sidebar.tsx:64-65) already used window.location.href = '/'. It does not use the new helper but behaves the same.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: Finishing setup in public mode also ends in a full page load of /admin, though no cookie changed.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Happens once per install at the end of the wizard. The user sees a full reload instead of a client transition.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: After a successful complete-setup, the `finally` block re-enables the finish button while the full page load is in flight, so a second click can POST complete-setup again.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Needs a click during the short reload after the last wizard step. The user still lands on /admin.

regression_risks: Negative navigation assertions in the setup tests still target pushMock, which can no longer be called (R1). A navigate-on-failure regression would pass.
loadFullPage is mocked everywhere (R2). A change to its body would not be caught.
window.location.href does not prepend a Next.js basePath. next.config.ts sets none today (per r1).
test_coverage: unlock/__tests__/page.test.tsx:45-59 checks loadFullPage targets for an empty redirect, an encoded path, a path with a query, '//evil.example' and 'https://evil.example', and that push/replace are not called.
page.test.tsx:61-78 asserts that loadFullPage is not called on a wrong password or a network failure. These negative tests were correctly migrated.
CompleteStep.test.tsx:47-60 and eight SetupWizard tests assert loadFullPage('/admin') on success, so reverting CompleteStep.tsx:58 to router.push would be caught.
The negative tests CompleteStep.test.tsx:77 and SetupWizard.test.tsx:499/921/946 assert only pushMock and are vacuous (R1).
Surviving mutation (from reading): moving loadFullPage into the finally block, or calling it before the res.ok check.
Surviving mutation (from reading): changing the fullPageLoad.ts body to a non-navigating call.
not_verified: Tests were not executed. I have no command tool, so mutation results come from reading the code.
Whether a real browser shows fresh sidebar, addon and WebSocket state after the full load at /admin was not checked.
I did not check whether /admin middleware or the server redirects a freshly set-up install somewhere else.
I read SetupWizard.test.tsx only around the changed hunks and pushMock usages, not the whole file.

coverage.reason: Read lines 470-529 and 890-959. Grepped every pushMock/loadFullPageMock usage (lines 4-12, 50-51, 203, 499, 502, 524, 753, 795, 834, 880, 921, 946, 959).

trajectory: There was one code round after r1. a321dac75 did not add a branch or state. It replaced the inline window.location.assign in unlock/page.tsx with a shared loadFullPage helper and applied the same helper to CompleteStep's existing success path, which resolves r1 R2. It also removed the router dependency from CompleteStep and the location stub from the unlock test. a97f53fa1 only shortened the rules bullet. 0f84750fb and c3602265e are review records. No round repeats a branch, state or prediction that an earlier round added. This is consolidation, not patching. The one leftover is that negative test assertions were not migrated with the positive ones.
